name: @aerie/ui
//: No build step on purpose: this package ships .tsx and .css source and the consuming app's Vite bundles it. That keeps a token edit a one-file edit with no publish/compile round-trip, and it is why the exports below point straight at src/.
//standalone: ./standalone/topbar is the bar for pages that are NOT React apps - Swagger UI and the logo export (see src/standalone/topbar.ts). It is a side-effecting entry point and is deliberately outside the '.' barrel: importing it mounts a bar. Every export key has to start with './' or Node rejects the whole map, which is why this note lives out here.
